title: 第78章 邪道现身

第78章 邪道现身-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

经过上次林浩宇的案子，王磊因为破案有功，局里已经准备提拔他兼任副支队长了。

王磊很痛快的答应了，他知道吴姜这种奇人，不会无缘无故的让他查一个人，两次合作下来，他已经认可吴姜了，说不定这次，还能让他再立一大功呢。

安排完后，吴姜抱着这幅新的仕女图，转身离开了墨韵轩。

他心里清楚，对方这次送过来的画，绝对不简单，大概率是来试探他的成色，看看他到底有几斤几两。

吴姜没有回墨香居，也没有回家，而是开车直奔城郊的野外，坐在车里等着。

天黑之后，吴姜刚拿着仕女图下车，那幅仕女图就脱离他的手中，自动飞到半空，缓缓展开。

一个风韵多姿，我见犹怜的身影，缓缓从画中走了出来。

吴姜眼睛一瞪，下意识地爆了句粗口：“我靠，小倩？！”

他活这么大，还没见过这么漂亮的女人——不，女鬼，比起他年少时的梦中情人，有过之而无不及。

女鬼眉眼间满是风情，却又带着几分楚楚可怜，让人忍不住心生怜惜，举手投足之间，都透着一股风情万种的韵味。

女鬼的脚上没有穿鞋子，白皙纤细的脚腕上，挂着一副小巧玲珑的铃铛，走动间，铃铛发出清脆的响声。

那一双玉足，白皙细腻，绝对是无数足控党梦寐以求的模样，绝对属于可玩年系列。

女鬼悬浮在半空中，即便没有风，她的裙摆也在轻轻晃动，隐隐露出一截白皙的小腿，让人忍不住想要窥探裙下风景。

吴姜下意识地咽了一口唾沫，对方这是换套路了，用女鬼来考验自己的定力来了。

女鬼冲着吴姜嫣然一笑，眉眼含春，风情万种，让吴姜直呼受不了，赶忙默念清心咒。

此刻他无比佩服自己的先见之明，早早将清心咒兑换了，不然，今天非得栽一个跟头不可。

After the last Lin Haoyu case, the bureau was ready to promote Wang Lei to concurrently serve as deputy detachment leader because of his merits in solving the case.

Wang Lei readily agreed. He knew that a strange person like Wu Jiang would not let him investigate a person for no reason. After two cooperations, he had already recognized Wu Jiang. Maybe this time, he could make another great contribution.

After the arrangements were made, Wu Jiang hugged the new picture of a lady and turned around to leave Mo Yunxuan.

He knew in his heart that the painting the other party sent this time was definitely not simple. It was most likely to test his quality and see how much he weighed.

Wu Jiang did not return to Mo Xiangju or go home. Instead, he drove straight to the countryside on the outskirts of the city and sat in the car waiting.

After dark, Wu Jiang just got out of the car with the picture of a lady, and the picture of a lady fell out of his hand, automatically flew into the air, and slowly unfolded.

A charming figure that I felt pity for slowly walked out of the painting.

Wu Jiang's eyes widened and he cursed subconsciously: "Holy shit, Xiaoqian?!"

In all his life, he has never seen such a beautiful woman - no, a female ghost, even worse than the dream girl of his youth.

The female ghost's eyebrows are full of amorous feelings, but there is also a bit of pitifulness, which makes people feel pity for her. There is a charming charm in every move and every move.

The female ghost had no shoes on her feet, and a pair of small and exquisite bells hung on her fair and slender ankles. The bells made a crisp sound when she walked around.

That pair of jade feet, white and delicate, is definitely the look that countless foot lovers dream of, and it definitely belongs to the playable year series.

The female ghost is suspended in mid-air. Even if there is no wind, the hem of her skirt is swaying slightly, faintly revealing a section of her white calf, which makes people want to peek at the scenery under the skirt.

Wu Jiang swallowed subconsciously. The other party had changed his tactics and used a female ghost to test his determination.

The female ghost smiled brightly at Wu Jiang, her eyebrows were full of beauty, and she was so charming that Wu Jiang couldn't stand it, so he hurriedly recited the heart-clearing mantra silently.

At this moment, he greatly admired his foresight in redeeming the Pure Heart Spell early, otherwise, he would have suffered a setback today.
